lng_intro_about2:
Welcome to the moregram Desktop app.
It's fast and secure.
lng_settings_restart_hint: Changing options shown in red will take effect only after app restart.
lng_settings_material_appearance_about: Optional Material-inspired radii. Capsule, density and chat-detail policies remain independent. Upstream appearance remains the default; Material Day and Material Dark are available in Chat Settings with the existing accent selector.
lng_settings_font_policy_about: Font policies require restart. Exact size uses the chosen font's own Latin and CJK metrics to avoid mismatched baselines. Avoid synthetic bold falls back to normal weight when no semibold face is available. TELEGRAM_DESKTOP_UI_FONT_WEIGHT (100–900) is parsed once at startup and overrides this weight.
lng_settings_hide_proxy_icon_connected_a: Connecting and retry states remain visible. Restart is required.
lng_settings_skip_message_desc: Allow ALT+↑/↓ shortcut to skip to next unread chat
lng_net_speed_boost_desc: Warning: changing this parameter to high values on slow networks can make it even worse. Use it at your own risk.
lng_show_emoji_button_as_text_desc: If you can't see an emoji button, please turn on this option.
lng_radio_controller_desc: Note: Radio controller is an experimental bot for controlling your music streaming session.
lng_auto_unmute_desc: Note: Auto unmute when you've joined the voice chat.
lng_settings_hide_messages_desc: Note: IT IS NOT REALLY HIDE! Messages are still available to view, but text will be converted to Spoiler and media won't auto download.
lng_net_boost_restart_desc:
You'll need to restart app to change network boost.

Restart now?
lng_show_messages_id_desc: Changes will take effect immediately after restart.
lng_action_group_migrate: The group was upgraded to a supergroup
lng_sure_upgrade_group: Are you sure you want to upgrade this group to supergroup?
lng_chat_upgrade_warning: Note: This action can not be undone
lng_user_not_found:
404 - User not found.
Note: You must have "seen" the user before opening this link.
lng_hd_video_hint: Video bitrate is changed! Rejoin a voice chat if you've already joined.
lng_bitrate_controller_desc: Warning: changing this parameter to high values may affect user on slow networks.
lng_bitrate_controller_hint: Audio bitrate is changed! Rejoin a voice chat if you've already joined.
lng_settings_enhanced_blocklist_fetching: Please wait a moment, fetching blocklist...
lng_settings_experimental_about: Warning! These are experimental settings. Some may not work. Others may break the app. Any of them may disappear in the next version without a trace. Use at your own risk.
lng_settings_experimental_irrelevant: This option isn't relevant for your system.
lng_settings_experimental_toast_export: Experimental settings code copied to clipboard.
lng_settings_experimental_toast_import_i: Clipboard does not contain a valid experimental settings code.
lng_settings_experimental_toast_import_s: Experimental settings imported from code in clipboard.
lng_settings_experimental_toast_import_u: Experimental settings code is valid, but data format is not supported.
lng_settings_experimental_forum_hide_cha: Don't keep a narrow column of chat list.
lng_settings_experimental_dialogs_unread: Keep unmuted unread chats on top
Sort chats with new unmuted messages right below the pinned ones and keep them there until you read them.
lng_settings_experimental_dialogs_mute_i: Show a small mute icon next to the chat name for muted chats.
lng_settings_experimental_use_modern_cha: Open chats through the new section.
lng_settings_experimental_auto_scroll_in: Mark as read of inactive chat
Mark new messages as read and scroll the chat even when the window is not in focus.
lng_settings_experimental_moderate_commo: Ban users from several groups at once.
lng_settings_experimental_classic_profil: Reverts the profile cover scroll to the previous (filler-based) implementation.
lng_settings_experimental_unlimited_mess: Allow text-only message bubbles to expand beyond the default maximum width.
lng_settings_experimental_mac_cmd_reply_: Mac: instant reply on Cmd + Up/Down
Reply to the previous or next message right away on Cmd + Up/Down, instead of first moving the text cursor to the start or end of the input field. Hold Shift to move the cursor as before.
lng_settings_experimental_hide_ai_button: Hide the AI Tools button in message compose fields.
lng_settings_experimental_force_compose_: Force in one-column mode the embedded search in chats.
lng_settings_experimental_view_profile_i: Add "View Profile" to context menu in chat list
lng_settings_experimental_show_peer_id_b: Show peer IDs from API below their Bio / Description. Add contact IDs to exported data.
lng_settings_experimental_show_channel_j: Show Channel Joined Date in Profile
Show when you join Channel under its Description.
lng_settings_experimental_profile_media_: Show shared media as tabs in the profile.
Replace the shared media buttons in profiles with a strip of tabs holding the media lists inline. Work in progress.
Split profile media tab into photos and videos.
Show separate photo and video tabs in profiles instead of a single combined media tab.
lng_settings_experimental_tabbed_panel_s: Show Emoji / Stickers / GIFs panel only after a click.
lng_settings_experimental_unlimited_rece: Display as much recent stickers as the server provides
lng_settings_experimental_disable_autopl: Disable auto-play of the next track
Disable auto-play of the next Audio file / Voice Message / Video message.
lng_settings_experimental_external_media: Use system media viewer instead of the internal one.
lng_settings_experimental_ffmpeg_multith: Allow FFmpeg to use a thread pool for decoding, typically a thread per CPU thread.
lng_settings_experimental_custom_notific: Allow to disable native notifications even if custom notifications are broken on this platform
lng_settings_experimental_gnotification_: Force enable GLib's GNotification. When disabled, autodetect is used.
lng_settings_experimental_mac_modern_not: Use UserNotifications framework for native notifications (macOS 10.14+). System asks for notifications permission on first launch. Once used, it stays in use even if turned off, because macOS stops showing the older notifications.
lng_settings_experimental_fractional_sca: Follow system interface scale settings exactly.
lng_settings_experimental_high_dpi_downs: Follow system interface scale settings exactly (another approach, likely better quality).
lng_settings_experimental_use_qt_rhi_des: Render the main window on the GPU instead of the CPU.
lng_settings_experimental_force_angle_de: Use ANGLE for accelerated media and calls. Render the main window on the CPU.
lng_settings_experimental_enable_vulkan_: Use Vulkan for GPU rendering instead of OpenGL when it is available.
lng_settings_experimental_freetype_desc: Use the font engine from Linux instead of the system one.
lng_settings_experimental_new_windows_si: Adjust size of new chat windows
Open new windows with a size of the main window.
lng_settings_experimental_prefer_ipv6_de: Prefer IPv6 if it is available. Require "Try connecting through IPv6" to be enabled
lng_settings_experimental_skip_url_schem: Don't re-register tg:// URL scheme on autoupdate.
lng_settings_experimental_deadlock_detec: Check once every 30 seconds that main thread is still responsive.
lng_settings_experimental_webview_debug_: Right click and choose Inspect in the webview windows. (on macOS launch Safari, open from Develop menu)
lng_settings_experimental_webview_legacy: Skip modern CoreWebView2 check and force using legacy Edge WebView on Windows.
lng_settings_experimental_fast_buttons_m: Trigger inline keyboard buttons by 1-9 keyboard keys.
lng_settings_experimental_folder_favorit: Favorite button at the bottom of the folders strip that opens a tg:// or t.me/ link.
